content: Prompt injection defense for untrusted pasted/dictated text: no single reliable fix. Layer: (1) put untrusted text in a separate user message / clearly delimited block with randomized delimiters (Microsoft Spotlighting), strict boundary declaration ('data not instructions') outperforms contextual explanation; (2) constrain output to a fixed schema so free-form model instructions can't take effect; (3) never let extraction output trigger side effects without human review; (4) treat all model output as potentially malicious; (5) monitor/eval for injection. For this app: dictated text becomes model input, agent only proposes drafts, human publishes - keep that invariant.
